# monitorable_notification_channels (Data Source)

Lists the organization's notification channels: id, type, name and whether each is enabled. Channels are managed in the dashboard and their settings are never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Channels are managed in the dashboard; their settings are never exposed.
data "monitorable_notification_channels" "all" {}

output "enabled_channel_names" {
  value = [for c in data.monitorable_notification_channels.all.channels : c.name if c.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) The notification channels, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel currently receives notifications.
- `id` (String) The channel id, a decimal integer.
- `name` (String) The channel's name.
- `type` (String) The channel type as the API reports it, for example `email` or `slack`.
